parameters.content:
## Email intake
Every minute: reads the unread emails sent to purchasing@nexora.example, turns each one into a purchase request, submits it to NEXORA **on behalf of the sender**, and answers the sender.

The backend checks everything (sender is a known requester, fields, rules). Locally the mailbox is Mailpit, read through its API; in production, an IMAP or Outlook trigger replaces the first two nodes.

parameters.jsCode:
// The email does not follow the template: send it back.
const email = $json;
const text = 'Your email could not be read as a purchase request.

'
  + 'Write one field per line, then attach the quotes:

'
  + 'Reference: PR-2026-01234
Department: Maintenance
Supplier: SUP-0002
'
  + 'Category: spare_parts
Item code: MRO-BRG-6205 (optional)
'
  + 'Description: Ball bearings 6205-2RS for line 3
Quantity: 20
Unit price: 8.40
'
  + 'Currency: EUR
Justification: Preventive maintenance of line 3
'
  + 'Needed by: 2026-12-01
CapEx: no
';
return { json: { to: email.sender, subject: `[NEXORA] Not understood: ${email.subject}`, text } };
